purpose: Pins the exact HITEMP line-list bytes and TIPS partition sums from which the derived CO2/H2O Planck-mean tables in this directory were computed. Raw .par bytes are NOT redistributed in this repository; they are re-obtainable from HITRANonline by any (free) account holder and verified against these digests.
quantity_semantics: Planck-mean absorption coefficient kappa_P(T_gas, T_radiation) per species, in the optically-thin limit of FIRE_SMOKE_DESIGN.md section 3.5. Stored as a per-molecule cross-section (cm^2/molecule), hence pressure-independent in this limit; the m^-1 atm^-1 column assumes 1 atm partial pressure. Line shape parameters do not enter this quantity and are discarded during reduction. NOT valid for transmission, optically-thick transfer, or band-resolved radiative transfer.

source_files.root_note: paths relative to the operator's local HITEMP archive; digests are over the exact bytes as served
